+def _interval_solver(data, capacity, largest):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    if mandatory & blocked or len(mandatory) > k:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    for subset in combinations(options, k):
+        ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in subset))
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in subset:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        active = []
+        valid = True
+        for job in sorted(subset, key=lambda x: (x["start"], x["end"], x["id"])):
+            active = [end for end in active if end > job["start"]]
+            active.append(job["end"])
+            if len(active) > capacity:
+                valid = False
+                break
+        if not valid:
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and
+                 (ids > best_ids if largest else ids < best_ids))):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
+
+
+def _build_interval(capacity, largest):
+    return lambda data: _interval_solver(data, capacity, largest)
+
+
+def _build_ledger():
+    def rounded(numerator, mode):
+        if mode == "half_up":
+            return (numerator + 5000) // 10000
+        return numerator // 10000
